rationale: B wins because it has the discipline A lacks: it refuses "Why patients are choosing compounded semaglutide over branded drugs" as a hallucinated customer story instead of laundering it into an angle. A's "Priced out of branded weight-loss drugs, patients turn to compounded prescriptions instead" is tempting, but the supplied facts give no patients, no adoption, and no concrete price. B still has a bad twitch in "bets its margins," but its proof demands and next step keep the founder out of fact-check trouble.
gaps_in_A: "Priced out of branded weight-loss drugs, patients turn to compounded prescriptions instead" overstates behavior the update does not prove. Access is plausible; actual patients turning to compounded prescriptions is not in the facts.

"Hims & Hers pairs at-home blood testing with prescribing, betting personalization sells better than price" invents a sales preference. The update says lab testing personalizes treatment; it does not say personalization beats price.

"A newly profitable Hims & Hers doubles down" uses a blacklisted cliche, and it sits too close to "Freshly profitable Hims & Hers bets its next act". Two angles are orbiting the same public-company/regulatory-risk story.
"differentiate from prescription-mill competitors" is loaded and unsupported. If you want to call competitors prescription mills, bring evidence or cut the sneer.
gaps_in_B: "A newly profitable Hims & Hers bets its margins on compounded weight-loss drugs" reaches past the facts. Profitability is given; a margin thesis is not.
"Decay: 4hr" on the FDA angle is fake precision. The update gives a launch and an existing risk flag, not a four-hour regulatory clock.
"end-to-end care models" is blacklist sludge in an otherwise usable lab-testing angle. Say what the model includes; do not reach for brochure language.

"here's how a telehealth seller is launching anyway" implies the answer is known. The facts only give provider review and an unnamed supply source, so the headline should keep the question open until proof arrives.
